criteria.criterion: In a powershell call, Invoke-Expression, Invoke-Command, Start-Process, Start-Job, Start-ThreadJob, Invoke-Item and every listed alias are denied wherever a command name stands, case-insensitively and with a path or .exe, using the command name exactly as written.
criteria.evidence: internal/fence/judge.go:325-346 defines all listed names and aliases and strips paths/.exe case-insensitively; internal/fence/wrappers_test.go:48-97 exercises each name and alias directly, after a pipe and semicolon, in uppercase and as a path/.exe, preserving the written token.

criteria.criterion: The same W2 denials apply after pipelines, separators and pwsh/powershell -Command wrappers and inside a W3 parenthesized pipeline.
criteria.evidence: internal/fence/judge.go:286-307 retains and judges parsed PowerShell commands when later parsing fails, and internal/fence/wrappers_test.go:48-97 covers pipeline, separator, both wrapper routes and a parenthesized pipeline.

criteria.criterion: Every unquoted { in a powershell call is denied with the exact script-block guidance, including @{, & { } and cmdlet script blocks; quoted braces remain literal.
criteria.evidence: internal/fence/split.go:291-296 produces the exact script-block error for an unquoted brace, but internal/fence/judge.go:295-302 gives any earlier dynamic-command denial precedence whenever a later brace stops parsing; for example, `iex x; & {git push}` returns `iex is not allowed` instead of the required exact script-block guidance.

criteria.criterion: The bash tool keeps its existing brace-group and POSIX decisions; the simplified pwsh cmdlet forms named by the brief stay allowed; and no new PowerShell form outside W1-W3 is accepted.
criteria.evidence: internal/fence/split.go:291-296 gates brace refusal on syntaxPowerShell; internal/fence/wrappers_test.go:99-141 verifies bash brace-group behavior, quoted braces and all three named simplified cmdlet forms.

criteria.criterion: Committed Go tests cover every pinned command and alias, command position, case/path variant, script-block spelling and the bash non-regression, and the go check executes them.
criteria.evidence: internal/fence/wrappers_test.go:48-141 adds the command/alias, position, case/path, wrapper, parenthesized, script-block and bash/cmd cases; checks/go.log records the internal/fence package passing during the go check.

findings.summary: A later unquoted PowerShell script block loses its required exact guidance when any earlier parsed command is a W2-denied command, because shellMode returns that command's denial before the splitter's script-block error.

notes: Add a committed mixed case such as `iex x; & {git push}` and make the unquoted-brace refusal take precedence, while retaining the exact dynamic-command denial for parenthesized syntax that contains no brace.
